findings.summary: The error-word family matches common Athena words in feature requests, because no output noun, creation word or change word is required on that line.
findings.evidence: Family (i) fires on a whole word stale, wrong, broken, bug, bugs or regression anywhere in the request. Unlike families (ii) and (iii), it needs no output noun and has no creation-word or change-word exemption. In this repository, `stale` is everyday vocabulary for features. CHANGELOG.md has 796 'Read-ahead and the stale-reading re-check in the drain', 1481 '`stale_build` in the status JSON', 309/311 'a stale marker', 329 'a stale stamp' and 3072 'likely-stale jobs'. HISTORY.txt:574 has 'Add read-ahead and stale-reading re-check to the drain (A5)', a feature commit. `regression` shows up as 'regression test' and 'regression guards' (CHANGELOG.md:2552, 383), and `wrong` appears in gate specs such as 'a committed wrong page that must fail each check' (1386) and 'wrong-SHA' (3196). `has_phrase` counts only alphanumeric characters as word characters (reading.rs:3297), so `stale` matches inside `stale-reading` and `stale_build`, and `wrong` matches inside `wrong-SHA`. Any code reading with a Behavior criterion for such a feature would be refused. The reader would be told to invent a root cause and a test that fails on the base. That is the obvious false positive on common words that the soundness question asks about, and it pushes the replay share further above the 10% hold, which the plan already expects to exceed. Fix: Give family (i) the same guards as (iii). Require an output noun or an error frame on the same line (for example 'is wrong', 'shows the wrong', 'are stale', 'is broken'), and skip lines that hold a creation or change word. Drop `regression` when the next word is test, tests or guard, or drop it from the list. Treat `_` and `-` joined to a cue as part of one token, so `stale-reading`, `stale_build` and `wrong-SHA` are not cues. Add corpus accept cases from the real shapes above, such as `Add read-ahead and stale-reading re-check to the drain` and `Add a regression test for the walk`, and add them to the risk list.

findings.summary: Criterion 2 asks for a case rebuilt from the request of job 20261103-201526-t4qv. The plan uses commit and changelog wording instead and says so, which falls short of the criterion's literal text.
findings.evidence: A Grep for 201526-t4qv and 231808-3gkq finds nothing in the snapshot. The only wording available is HISTORY.txt:13 and CHANGELOG.md:375/384, and the plan uses it, writes that into the case source and raises it as an open question. Fix: Keep the stated deviation. Write the case `source` in the corpus style (`... ; rebuilt from the changelog and commit subject`), so a later job with access to records/ can swap in the verbatim request.

summary: Round 4 fixes the gaps from earlier rounds. Cue text now covers `athena retry`: the request is `try again on <id>` (reading.rs:1119, 1310) and `attempt` reaches `refusing_check` from the gate call at reading.rs:663. Steward template lines are removed only when the title line is present. The `only` rule is narrowed. I read the code the plan relies on: `refusing_check` and its `step!` list (3119-3144), `check_code_survey` and its precondition (3453), `has_phrase` (3293), the corpus `Case`, `case`, `earlier`, `root_cause_request` and `INPUT_FORMS` (17 entries), and the briefs.rs rule-count test (3954-3985, which asserts 6, says 'six rule lines' and has a 2400-byte limit). All of it exists as described. The demonstrations run through the real `refusing_check` and `check_root_cause_criterion` entry points and would fail without the new step. One soundness problem remains. The error-word family (stale, wrong, regression, bug, broken) has none of the output-noun, creation-word or change-word guards the other families have. Because `has_phrase` treats `-` and `_` as word breaks, it also matches `stale-reading`, `stale_build` and `wrong-SHA`. These words are routine feature vocabulary in this repository (CHANGELOG.md:796, 1481, 309, 2552; HISTORY.txt:574), so ordinary feature readings would be refused and the replay share would rise. Narrowing that family is a small, contained fix, so the verdict is revise.
